summary.text: Sophia Chitlik is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 22, covering Durham County, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Lakeshia Alston.
An investor, she took office in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Chitlik earned a bachelor's degree from New York University in 2011, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as investor.
She assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Mike Woodard, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.

The General Assembly's website shows her committee assignments in Appropriations on Education/Higher Education, Education/Higher Education, Judiciary and Regulatory Reform, along with the Joint Legislative Oversight Committees on Justice and Public Safety and on Information Technology.
